import gzip,json
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import digest,file_digest,write_json
old_path=Path("docs/experiments/results/confirmation-engine-001/view.json.gz")
new_path=Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001/confirmation-export-002/view.json")
old=json.loads(gzip.decompress(old_path.read_bytes()));new=json.loads(new_path.read_bytes())

assert changed==["dependencies"],changed
report={"schema":"nisayon.confirmation-semantic-comparison.v1","old_compressed_sha256":file_digest(old_path),"new_view_sha256":file_digest(new_path),"changed_top_level_fields":changed,"old_dependencies":old["dependencies"],"new_dependencies":new["dependencies"],"identical_non_dependency_fields":sorted(set(new)-{"dependencies"}),"non_dependency_content_sha256":digest({k:v for k,v in new.items() if k!="dependencies"}),"original_numeric_inputs_and_historical_outcomes_unchanged":True,"new_execution":False}
write_json(new_path.parent.parent/"confirmation-readback-002/confirmation-semantic-comparison-002.json",report)
print(json.dumps({"changed":changed,"unchanged_fields":report["identical_non_dependency_fields"]}))
